articleTitle: Optimal Placement of Electric Vehicle Charging Station with V2G Provision using Symbiotic Organisms Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are one of the most efficient technologies for the sustainable transport sector in the present world considering its almost nil carbon emission. To cope up with the ever-increasing demand of power for EV charging, the distribution system's power loss increases and significant changes in voltage profile occurs. Improper installation of the EV Charging Stations (EVCS) significantly reduces the power quality of the distribution network, impacting its efficient process. In this paper, the installation of EVCS in the IEEE 33 bus radial distribution system is being outlined. The distribution system has been split into three areas in order to reach charging facilities in various locations within an area and it has been ensured that one charging station is allocated in each area. The issue is being categorized as the optimization problem and it has been dealt using Symbiotic Organisms Search Algorithm (SOS) for finding the optimal location of EVCS.

articleTitle: Load Flow Analysis Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In Newton Raphson load flow analysis, scheduled active power, scheduled reactive power for each generating unit, Active power injections (from bus), Reactive power injections (from bus), Active power injections (to bus), Reactive power injections (to bus), Active power loss and Reactive power loss in each branch for IEEE 14 Bus System and IEEE 30 bus system are calculated. Graphs are plotted for active power loss and reactive power loss for both IEEE 14 Bus System and IEEE 30 bus system.

articleTitle: Comparison And Validation Of Regression Model For Estimation Of Global Solar Radiation Using Python
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The major purpose behind this paper is to compare linear, quadratic and cubic regression analysis for estimation of global solar radiation and validating them by comparing the calculated data with the standard measured data given by metrological department for providing a suitable model for estimation. This paper analyses the Angstrom-Prescott's model, Ogleman's model and Samuel's model are used for estimation of global solar radiation. After the experimental data being collected from the aforesaid models the data is being validated using Mean Absolute Percentage Error, Mean Bias Error, Root Mean Square Error, t-statistic. After the validation, a comparative study of the aforesaid models is done and finally a suitable model has been put forward.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection from X-ray Images Using a New CNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Detection of COVID-19 has been a very active field of research with thousands of papers published after outbreaks of COVID-19 in the world. Computer-Aided Design (CAD) based studies have a significant role in the medical field thanks to rapidly developing technology. To help radiologists speed up the diagnostic process, CAD with convolutional neural networks (CNN) can be used as decision support mechanisms. Furthermore, CNN has the power to learn various image features automatically, and it may offer an effective way for COVID-19 detection. In this paper, we propose a CNN design for COVID-19 detection. We used a data set of X-ray images collected from two publicly available sources. This data set consists of 400 images of which 200 are COVID-19 and 200 are healthy. First, we preprocessed all data sets and then divided them by randomly allocating 70 % for training and 30 % for the test. We obtained the accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity rate of our model as 96.11%, 98.89 %, and 93.33 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Analog Beamforming Transceiver for Millimeter-Wave Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper describes a millimeter wave (MMW) transceiver for the fifth-generation (5G) that operates at 24.5 GHz to 27 GHz. The intermediate frequency (IF) is from 5GHz to 6GHz. In order to achieve a local oscillator (LO) with low phase noise, phase locked loop (PLL) is adopted. Through the radio frequency (RF) phase shifter, the transceiver can realize analog beamforming (ABF) which can scan up to ±40° in the elevation plan (E- Plane) and azimuth plane (H - Plane). And to ensure the stability of the system, the antenna array should be integrated on the RF board. The integrated substrate coaxial line (SICL) and short pin are used to broaden the bandwidth. The worst isolation between adjacent antenna elements is −15dB and the effective isotropic radiate power (EIRP) of the phased array can achieve 46dBm. The system measured error vector magnitude (EVM) of 64-QAM, 128-QAM and 256-QAM is below 5%.

articleTitle: Advanced Power Management System for Renewable energy-based fusion Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The fusion system is comprised of bidirectional converters that interconnected ac and dc microgrid networks. The ac microgrid combines AC power supply sources and AC loads, whereas the dc microgrid connects DC power supply sources and DC loads. To compensate for the solar output power fluctuation, a battery storage system (BSS) is integrated with a dc network. The proposed fusion microgrid system operates in either grid connected mode or autonomous mode. The proposed enhanced power flow algorithm controls power flow in a fusion microgrid. Wind speed and solar irradiance level unpredictability and irregular behavior are also taken into consideration in control and operation of system. The simulation results show that when the mode of system changes, the system can control and manage stably operation under the projected advanced power management system.

articleTitle: CNN Models and Machine Learning Classifiers for Analysis of Goiter Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A Goiter is an abnormal growth of the thyroid gland. The thyroid is a butterfly-shaped gland located at the base of our neck, right under Adam's apple. Goiter can be diagnosed using a variety of methods, including blood tests, antibody tests, and ultrasonography. In this paper, we describe a technique for detecting Goiter that employs pre-trained CNN models and Machine Learning (ML) classifiers. This method comprises an Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithm that examines pictures for swelling in the neck and accurately identifies whether it is Goiter or not. We have used three pre-trained feature extracting models: VGG16, InceptionV3, and VGG19. The features are then fed to the distinct ML classifiers such as logistic regression, random forest, support vector machine, KNN, neural network, naive bayes, and adaBoost. The results guarantee an early diagnosis of Goiter illness, allowing the patient to get appropriate treatment.

articleTitle: “Design & Simulation of Brushless DC Motor Using ANSYS for EV Application”
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents design & simulation study of brushless dc motor (BLDC) using ANSYS software (Version 2019R2 ANSYS- Maxwell RMxprt, PExprt & Simplorer). As, BLDC motor carry only magnets i.e. permanent magnet on rotor, become the best alternative to the conventional motors with all required features & capabilities for electric vehicle (EV) applications. The development of EV, using particular motor has become thrust research area. As major part of EV have to offer high efficiency, high power density, high torque, easy control, wide speed operating range & maintenance free operations. Recent trends in this sector will increase the benefits of electric vehicle research using permanent magnet machines. 2D and 3D designs are studied and performed in computer research laboratory using ANSYS software. Result data along with waveforms are recorded to calculate efficiency of BLDC motor. Design & simulation outcome for torque, speed, magnetic flux density, flux linkages, magnetic field strength, current density, flux lines along with inductance, current & induced voltage for 2D design of BLDC motor are presented.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Control of COVID Vaccine Storage Temperature Using IoT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Corona virus (COVID-19) is an infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Till now, vaccination is the most effective way of fighting this pandemic of COVID-19. This paper proposes a system which will monitor and control the temperature of the vaccine storage rooms. Here an Internet of things and Machine Learning system has been developed which will measure the real time temperature of the room and will control the temperature automatically. It will try to keep the temperature in the given region, it will predict the temperature of next twenty minutes with the help of Machine learning algorithm-linear regression, it will watch for an anomaly using Z-score analysis, it will also watch if the temperature crosses upper or lower threshold. If any of the above abnormality is detected, we will get notified online through a message, the system will maintain the temperature and the workers will also get alarmed by a led and a buzzer which will work different for each significant case.

articleTitle: Analytical Analysis of Solar PV Module Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The energy from sun accounts for the major part of renewable energy which is utilized in this planet. Photovoltaics (PV) is a lenient way of producing electrical energy by transforming solar radiation into electricity in the form of current by using proper silicon-based semiconductor which exhibits the photovoltaic effect. The work presented in this paper is a simulation-based study of solar PV cell/module using the Simulink library present in MATLAB. The simulated model is then tested under different values of temperature and solar irradiance in order to conduct a behavioural study on a solar PV cell/module and the results are presented along with the model. The presented study is very useful in knowing the basic principles and limitations of a solar PV cell/module.

articleTitle: Efficiency Enhancement of DSSC with ZnO/rGO nanocomposite
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In the present work ZnO nanowires where synthesized using sol gel method the absorbance of 339 nm and bandgap of 3.38 eV were observed. The rGO was synthesized by using modified Hummers method and its absorbance and bandgap were calculated as 230 nm and 2.0 eV. The DSSCs were fabricated with ZnO using natural black mulberry dye and N719 dye, the efficiency of 3.0 % and 4.1% was observed. With the addition of reduced graphene oxide, the nanocomposite ZnO/rGO was used as photoanode for DSSCs. An enhancement in efficiency was obtained with addition of rGO. The efficiency of 5.94 % was observed with ZnO/rGO using natural black mulberry dye and efficiency of 7.3% was observed with ZnO/rGO and N719 dye. For all observations potassium iodide was used as electrolyte.

articleTitle: Prediction of Rainfall using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent years due to global warming the rainfall pattern has been affected and it has led to some erratic rains that are experienced in some regions of India. This affects India as it is an economy mainly dependent on agriculture. The aim of this project is to predict rainfall as yes or no on a particular day. We collected data about rainfall patterns and how it is dependent on parameters like wind, temperature, pressure, humidity. Instead of using traditional regression models we used classification model-Random Forest in our approach. We used an open-source software Jupyter Notebook and the coding language python, which is dynamic and supports vast libraries of which we used numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn and seaborn. Decision tree fails for a large amount of data. Here comes the random forest into the picture.

articleTitle: High Voltage Trigger Generator for Magnetic Pulse Welding System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In an electromagnetic welding/forming system high current and high voltage are delivered to the welding / forming coil. The voltage of the order of 20kV and current as high as 400kA is delivered to the load. High energy capacitor banks are used in this system which is charged to a specific voltage and discharged through a spark gap (trigatron type spark gap). Since the capacitor banks are discharged in parallel, the turn ON time of these spark gap switches should have minimum jitter/difference to deliver maximum energy at the rated frequency to the load. In this paper, the development of a fast-rising time Thyratron-based trigger generator is discussed.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: During this global pandemic, Face mask detection has seen an outstanding development in image processing and Computer vision. Face masks can be detected by observing patterns in an image using various machine learning algorithms. Here three machine learning algorithms were considered, namely, CNN(Convolutional Neural Network), SVM(Support Vector Machine), and PCA (Principal Component Analysis). Dataset used consists of images of people with masks and without masks extracted from Kaggle. In this literature, the efficiency of the detection of face masks after performing K-cross validation has been calculated. All the algorithms yielded an accuracy above 90% with CNN being the highest with an accuracy of 98.6%.

Author Keywords: Machine learning Neural Networks Principle Component Analysis (PCA) Support Vector Machine(SVM) RELU Accuracy Epochs

articleTitle: YOLO Based Model for Garbage Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Air and water pollution are common cause of rotten rubbish. It produces harmful gases that comes in contact with the air and can cause respiratory problems in humans. Also, untreated waste leads to damage the vegetation around the landfill. Since, water resources are important to people and need to be protected by all means. In this regard, garbage collection is an important step in monitoring the environment and circulating in a large area, because manual monitoring can be time consuming. Therefore, identifying the garbage and monitoring with the minimum human intervention enables to remove them at appropriate times for a healthy environment. In this context, we explore yolo based model for garbage detection by collecting the pictures of garbage on the road or in bodies of water in real time. For further analysis the the YOLO frame that works on darknet is considered for positive effect on the visual perception of the object.

articleTitle: Voltage Control of a Standalone PV Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A PWM based fuzzy logic controller (FLC) control approach is implemented with the intention to control the voltage magnitude of DC load bus in an isolated photovoltaic and battery-based dc network. Double loop regulation strategy is adopted to control the voltage of load bus. The inner loop regulates the inductor current while the outer loop regulates the voltage of load bus. The two fuzzy logic controllers are used to control the process. The implementation of the control strategy is being explained in detail. The optimum power is derived from the photovoltaic panel during varying insolation condition by incremental conductance MPPT and is stepped up by the boost converter. The recommended scheme is simulated in the MATLAB/Simulink under varying irradiance conditions.

articleTitle: Assesment of DVR Using Conventional VSI and NPC-MLI To Mitigate Voltage Sag/Swell
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This work presents methods by which a DVR is used in mitigating power quality problems. This work present modeling and simulation analysis of a DVR using conventional Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) and Neutral Point Clamped multi-level inverter (NPC-MLI). The control of VSI is designed using synchronous reference frame-based PI controller and for NPC-MLI, direct feed forward controller is used. The feed forward controller processes the error signal and generates the switching pulse for NPC-MLI. The analysis of the designed DVR is carried out for non-linear loading, voltage sag as well as swell. DVR improves voltage profile and to mitigate sag using MALTAB Simulink environment.

Author Keywords: Cascade H Bridge Multi Level Inverter (CHB-MLI)

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Three-level NPC Inverter Fed PMSM Drives
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drive using vector control (VC) that allows more accurate speed control and smoother torque response is presented. This paper analyses and execute closed-loop vector control (VC) techniques such as space vector modulation field-oriented control (SVM - FOC), and space vector modulation direct torque and flux control (SVM-DTFC) for PMSM drive at constant load torque and speed variation. SVM-FOC, SVM-DTFC are used with 3-level neutral point clamped inverter (NPCI). NPCI provide better dc bus utilization for same DC bus voltage. The switching selection strategy of SVM is modified using the nearest three SVM to reduce the total harmonic distortion (THD). The MATLAB/Simulink results are presented to verify the effectiveness of control scheme.

articleTitle: Security Threats to Machine Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Machine Learning not only promises to solve issues, but it also has the potential to assist businesses in formulating forecasts and so enhancing decision-making. Machine learning, on the other hand, has security difficulties. This study examines the many security concerns that machine learning faces and how they might be mitigated. There are two types of security risks to ML systems: those that occur before model training and those that occur after model training. The document also offers information on a variety of additional threats that fall under these categories and target other sorts of data while posing varied hazards.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation of Parkinsonian Tremor and the Impact on it by DBS and Drugs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder that affects approximately 1-2% of the population above 60 years of age. PD is primarily characterized by motor symptoms like resting tremor, action tremor, akinesia, rigidity and postural instability. To evaluate various aspects of Parkinson's Disease and to follow the progression of disease, the physician utilizes Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS). Though it is widely used to evaluate the patients and determine the course of treatment, the absence of screening questions on many important aspects of PD, some metric flaws, inadequate instructions for examiners are few of the limitations. UPDRS considers resting and action tremor while evaluating a patient. Tremor can be defined as an involuntary rhythmic, asymmetric muscular activity, affecting the limbs, chin, lips, head, vocal cord and or entire body of the patients. It exists while the patient is resting or while performing various tasks. We attempted to quantify the tremor in PD patients with and without medication and compared the improvement while the patient is on treatment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Malware Detection- a Research Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Malware is a term that describes malicious software that is used to infect individual computers or an entire system. Malware is one of the most significant security risks that exists today on the Internet. Currently, the volume of malware is increasing at a quicker rate each year, posing a serious global security issue. Detecting malware with traditional signature-based methods is becoming more and more difficult because all modern malware applications have a lot of different layers to hide from detection or use side mechanisms to automatically upgrade to a newer version at short intervals to avoid detection by any antivirus software. In this study, we define malware and malware types in general, as well as a novel machine learning-based approach for detecting malware that is both effective and efficient, which we describe in detail in the following sections.

articleTitle: Real-time mobile application for classifying solid waste material into recyclable and non-recyclable using Image Recognition and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Several applications of deep neural network have come into the limelight these days, one of them is the classification of solid waste material. Enormous amount of waste in generated in a highly populated country like India. A large portion of this can be recycled for further uses. Recyclable waste is separated in the treatment plants and sent to the recycling units or simply dumped into the water bodies or waste lands. This article provides a workable solution for categorizing waste into various categories at the gross root level. The methodology adopted for this project is Convolutional Neural Network clubbed with Image Recognition concepts. It was found that the accuracy improved notably after augmenting the input data. The proposed system when integrated with front end apps, can be used at community level to segregate domestic waste, which will contribute to the reduction of generation of unused waste material.

articleTitle: Effect of thermal incorporation in IR - Drop analysis of multilayered network and its reduction technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The thermal influence of the self-heating (SH) effect in electronic devices on interconnects is explored in this paper. The self-heating effect in these devices will generate greater heat in structures, which may affect interconnect dependability. The RedHawk Tool is used to examine a chip design provided by STMicroelectronics in this study. Temperature variations in distinct metal layers, and self-heating impact are all part of the evaluation. Earlier technology didn't include the delta <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T$</tex> modelling in the design which is being considered here. Concept of de-coupling capacitors are employed to reduce power consumption in the design.

articleTitle: Implementation, Analysis and Comparison of different Control Strategies on RSC-MLC Integrated D-STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper includes analysis and comparison of different control strategies implemented on D-STATCOM (Distributed Static Synchronous Compensator) with RSC-MLC (Reduced Switch Count Multi-Level Converter) module. The conventional D-STATCOM DC link source is updated with the RSC-MLC module integrated with PVA (Photo Voltaic Array) for renewable power injection along with harmonic mitigation. The novel D-STATCOM is operated with different control structures proposed which are a) SRF theory (Synchronous Reference Frame) b) PQ (Active-Reactive Power) theory and performance of the device and the grid system is analyzed and compared. For this the test system is modeled in MATLAB Simulink environment with powergui toolbox for graphs generation with respect to time. For harmonic analysis FFT (Fast Fourier Transformation) analysis tool is used for determination of THD (Total Harmonic Distortion) of the voltages and currents of the system.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This For Optimal power flow, active power injections (from bus), Reactive power injections (from bus), Active power injections (to bus), Reactive power injections (to bus), active power loss, reactive power loss in each branch, injected active power, injected reactive power, total scheduled active power, total scheduled reactive power, scheduled active power and fuel cost for scheduled active power are calculated for both IEEE 14 Bus System and IEEE 30 bus system and graphs are plotted for total scheduled active power, total scheduled reactive power, scheduled active power and fuel cost for scheduled active power.

articleTitle: Fast and Accurate Water Region Classification from Remote Sensing Images Using Enhanced Convolutional Neural Network Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Water body area interpretation in remote sensing imagery plays a key role in analyzing the current scenario of existing water bodies for sustainable water management. Fast, accurate and precise monitoring of environmental resources is a critical aspect for managing them. Slow training time and low accuracy rate of traditional classification techniques arose the need to use deep neural networks. The proposed Enhanced Convolutional Neural Network uses Switchable Normalization to achieve fastest training time of about 6.294738 seconds by learning the importance weights among channel-wise, layer wise and mini-batch wise statistics (mean and variance). The proposed deep neural network classifier is trained over the GaoFen Image Dataset comprising of very high resolution images with multiple classes to prove the efficacy of the network. Comparative result analysis with the existing deep learning classifiers had been presented along with the future scope of the network.

articleTitle: Optimization of DCP dehazing algorithm through sky segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The Dark Channel Prior dehazing algorithm degrades scenes of the sky when attempting to dehaze them, ruining their quality by trying to find a solid scene that isn't present. Due to this, a simple algorithm to identify sky regions is proposed and applied in order to improve its output. The main procedure described in this paper is to replace the original image's sky region into the DCP-processed image. The result is a dehazed image through the DCP algorithm that has a natural looking sky region.

articleTitle: Limitations and improvements in Impedance Source Inverter Topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A survey of different topologies on impedance source converter has been described in this paper. Besides of merits and demerits modifications in topologies are described. A comparison in terms of inrush current, voltage stress on capacitor and devices, gain in voltage and components needed is mentioned. All these parameters, comparison and topology make the use of converter for a particular industrial application. The ZSI (Impedance source inverter) has a L-C network which provides a link between DC source and 3-phase VSI which makes it different from other kinds on converter. This is the main structural feature of ZSI as compared to conventional VSI (Voltage source inverter) and CSI (Current source inverter). The impedance source inverter overcome the academic, realistic and intangible barrier and restrictions of the conventional VSI and CSI converter and provides a innovative based conversion of power. The ZSI model can be apply to all conversion stages. The development of solar based photo voltaic cell and wind energy sources demands to increase large gain variety converters. The impedance source inverter implemented to overcome the drawbacks of existing converters. Impedance source inverter can step up, step down and convert power in one stage structure with no extra active switches with the advantage of easy control technique. However, this converter subject to several disadvantages likes voltage stresses and large size impedance network. Several researchers have concentrate their focal point to get better (ZSI) by satisfying these gaps. Paper shows all-inclusive study of (ZSI) topology and their modifications for a variety of applications. In this paper author identify the various draw backs of impedance source inverter like voltage stresses on IGBTs switches, large inrush current at starting, large size and complicated impedance network. To overcome all these difficulties a survey of voltage gain comparison of different topologies with PWM technique has discussed.

articleTitle: Layered optimization of multi-spherical Lumber lens
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The millimeter wave frequency band will play an increasingly important role in future communication. The luneburg lens antenna in the millimeter wave frequency band has the characteristics of high gain low side lobe, and multi-frequency scanning. The commonly used method is to build concentric spherical shells and give each layer of spherical shells a certain dielectric constant to approximate the realization of the luneburg lens. This paper proposes a new layered method of multi-spherical spherical luneburg lens, which increases the gain and reduces the side lobe compared with the traditional layered method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 4-bit and 8-bit KSA in 18nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The addition operation is required by any digital, analogue, or control system. The speed and accuracy with which the digital system operates is dependent on the functioning of adders. Adders are utilised in a variety of logical and arithmetic procedures. The goal of VLSI system design research is to improve the performance of digital systems, hence there is a strong incentive to examine and analyse adder architectures. The purpose here is to understand the family of faster adders available, such as the Ripple Carry Adder, Carry Look Ahead Adder, Carry Select Adder, and so on. This paper is about the Kogge Stone Adder in the 18nm FinFET model's technology node. It has a high PDP because it operates at a faster rate than its competitors. The adder is designed and built for bit lengths of 4 and 8, with random input data simulations used to evaluate its operations. Criteria such as power, performance, area, gate count, and PDP are used to construct a comparison. Every block used to construct the adder is inspected, and the results are graphically shown. In order to properly examine the parameters, the acquired data is tabulated.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance Parameters of Triple Metal Dual Gate Vertical Tunnel FET Biosensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper presents a triple metal dual-gate vertical TFET biosensor in order to identify the presence of various biomolecules which are present in the surroundings. The performance of the proposed biosensor is analyzed with the help of two-dimensional TCAD simulations. In the biosensing device, a hollow region is formed underneath the gate area, which gathers the biomolecules to be detected. The accumulated biomolecules in the cavity region lead to electrical changes in the device parameters. The effect of dielectric constant variation is investigated by analyzing the results obtained. Gate work function is also varied to find out its impact. The I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf> ratio and Subthreshold Swing (SS) are two performance characteristics that are investigated.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Band Patch Antenna Array for Automotive and Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel dual-band patch antenna array for automotive and industrial applications. The element is composed of a hairpin resonator, a U-slot resonator in the ground and a radiation patch from bottom to top, which can be used to realize dual-band operation. To further improve the impedance matching and gain characteristics, a new wideband power divider is employed. Finally, a 2 × 2 array antenna is implemented, which operates at 62 GHz industrial band and 77 GHz automotive band. Compared with traditional patch array antenna, this dual-band antenna system exhibits excellent performance in terms of compact size and frequency selectivity.

articleTitle: Android based advanced bus reservation system in the pandemic of Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Social distancing is one of the major requirements of Covid-19. India is a country with a huge population of middle and low financial income and they depend on public transportation to a large extent. In this context, to avoid social distancing while transportation, we propose, android based bus booking system. To achieve this purpose, we have used android studio, because it is an officially developed environment for Android OS. It is built on JetBrains' IntelliJ IDEA software that enables to provide a simple platform to users to check bus availability and reserve it with ease. The parameters like booking the seats between desired source and destination location, desired date, desired type of bus like AC or Non-AC, sleeper or sitting, reserving multiple tickets, and canceling them if required are considered.

articleTitle: Three Phase Distribution STATCOM Integrated with Solar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Static compensator (STATCOM) is a shunt compensation installed to eliminate harmonics generated by non-linear and unbalanced loading condition. Also there has been an increased use of Power Electronic Devices (PED) in control and sensitive equipments. Due to this sinusoidal voltage and current waveforms get distorted both at source side and load side. In this paper three phase Distribution-STATCOM (DSTATCOM) is designed to mitigate PQ issues related to voltage instability and harmonics. An inimitable concept of utilizing Solar Photovoltaic Power Generation (SPVPG) as DSTATCOM is presented. In this DSTATCOM is capable of integrating solar power with the AC utility system. The PV-DSTATCOM designed can regulate voltage by suppling active as well as reactive power demand of the system.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Low Powered Battery Management Circuit Using Adiabatic Logic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A lithium ion battery is accompanied by a battery management system to operate the battery efficiently and within safe operation region. We propose an improvised battery management system with low power consumption as compared to the available battery management systems. All the circuits are simulated and parameters are calculated using the PSPICE simulation tool. To achieve lower power consumption, diode free adiabatic logic-based comparator is employed in the charge balancing circuit. The performance parameters of the designed battery management system are same as compared to the available battery management systems. However, due to the incorporation of adiabatic logic technique which uses reversible logic, the power consumption is significantly reduced. The reduced power consumption of the designed battery management system makes it a potential candidate for the power efficient applications.

articleTitle: Real-time Alert System for Auxiliary Transformer Failures
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Auxiliary transformers are used extensively in railway systems. Indian Railways use them primarily to convert the 25-kilo volt AC supply into 230-240-volt AC supply as required for various applications. Due to their varied use, many of these auxiliary transformers are often positioned in remote locations. In case of failure of AT supply, no proper feedback system exists as of now. Due to this the lead time on failure attention increases rapidly depending on the location of the transformer. Sometimes this may result in signal failure leading to an increase in train traffic. To cut down on human effort and cost involved, as well as provide a system that continuously monitors these auxiliary transformers, an automated system based on GSM technology is suggested. This system periodically provides updates and generates immediate alerts in case of the occurrence of the failure of an auxiliary transformer, hence bringing a drastic reduction on lead time for failure attention where a failure escalates into costly service losses.

articleTitle: 8-Bit Modified Booth Multiplier using 20nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Multiplication is often performed via an Add and Shift operation, in which each multiplier bit generates one multiplicand multiple bit that must be added to the partial product. When the multiplier is bigger, a significant number of multiplicands must be added; as a result, the multiplier has a prolonged delay proportionate to the number of adding operations. To boost performance, we must decrease the additions operations, resulting in the minimum number of partial products generated. In this paper, an 8-bit Modified Booth multiplier using 20nm FinFETs for signed bit multiplication has been designed. It is built in such a way that power, delay, and area are efficient. It applies the concept of encoding the multiplier based on the bit pattern, which minimizes the number of partial products produced and hence the number of adders needed.

articleTitle: MIMO based high-speed underwater optical wireless communication using WDM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Since the last decade, the requirement for high-speed underwater communication has been increased drastically. The earlier system for underwater communication was based on the transmission of acoustics signals, which has limitations of low data rates and latency. As the demands of underwater real time signal transmission are increasing which requires higher data rate, one of the solutions could be optical wireless transmission. Optical signal carriers offer high channel Bandwidth and low latency. In this paper (MIMO) Multiple Input Multiple Output based (UOWC) Underwater Optical Wireless Communication using (WDM) Wavelength Division Multiplexing has been proposed. Employing a 4×4 MIMO structure improves the reception performance whereas 8-Channel WDM improves the data rates. The simulation results show the data rates of 4Gbps (8×500 Mbps) for the distance up to 300 meters in oceanic water using 450 nm wavelength with 0.1 nm spacing. The Bit Error Rate and Q factors are analyzed at different transmission distances and different transmitted LASER power levels.

articleTitle: ExFAURL Scanner: A Framework for Malware Detection in Binary files and URLs using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: With the evolution of technology, the power of massive production of data is leveraged for strengthening and growing business, research organizations, national intelligence, and individuals. Sensitive data which is meant to be secluded and kept safe is often sensed as vulnerable to exploitation through unintended users and malware attackers. With the means of traditional security techniques which are signature-based, the risks from polymorphic viruses and zero-day attacks are inconceivable and severe. Hence, the need for machine learning-based predictive modeling arises. A downloaded file even if malicious might not appear so at a glance but when installed and run might infect the entire system. Similarly, URLs can also host unsolicited content which when accessed by unsuspecting users bait trap to various types of scams. This paper focuses on developing a Web application that can distinguish a malicious or legitimate binary executable file and a URL using Machine Learning Algorithms.

articleTitle: Pragmatic Implementation of Reinforcement Algorithms For Path Finding On Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In this paper, pragmatic implementation of an indoor autonomous delivery system that exploits Reinforcement Learning algorithms for path planning and collision avoidance is audited. The proposed system is a cost-efficient approach that is implemented to facilitate a Raspberry Pi controlled four-wheel drive non-holonomic robot map a grid. This approach computes and navigates the shortest path from a source key point to a destination key point to carry out the desired delivery. Q learning and Deep-Q learning are used to find the optimal path while avoiding collision with static obstacles. This work defines an approach to deploy these two algorithms on a robot. A novel algorithm to decode an array of directions into accurate movements in a certain action space is also proposed. The procedure followed to dispatch this system with the said requirements is described, ergo presenting our proof of concept for indoor autonomous delivery vehicles.

articleTitle: Temperature Analysis of a Novel 5nm Stacked Oxide Top Bottom Gated Junctionless FinFET for improved switching and efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Temperature Analysis of a Novel Stacked Oxide Top Bottom Gated Junctionless Fin-shaped Field Effect Transistor (TBG JL FinFET) is described in this research paper. This examinations reveals the alteration of performance parameters with temperature for the Novel 5nm Stacked Oxide TBG JL FinFET. The Temperature Analysis is done on Silvaco TCAD tools for the Novel Stacked Oxide Top-Bottom Gated Junctionless FinFET and compared with the Conventional Junctionless FinFET structure. The device shows enhanced output performance at 200K while having less electric field near drain end concurrently, thus reducing the Short Channel Effects (SCEs) by a greater extent. The results from device simulation reveal that the Novel Stacked Oxide Top-Bottom Gated Junctionless FinFET has better analog performance over varied temperature range and lowers the Short Channel Effects (SCEs) a cut above the Conventional Junctionless FinFET.

articleTitle: Algorithm Development Analysis: searching and sorting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: The Development and analysis of algorithms are fundamental to all aspects of problem-solving: artificial intelligence, neural networks, fuzzy approaches, networking, operating systems, etc. It requires an understanding of the alternative solutions available for solving a computational problem, including the performance constraints accompanying a particular solution. It also involves an understanding of what it means for an algorithm to be correct as it thoroughly and efficiently solves the problem. Algorithm Development is necessary for traditional and complex problems, which are sometimes challenging to implement. This article gives an exact idea of algorithms and a straightforward approach to understand. There is a need to know the time complexity of an algorithm, sorting data, and searching a particular element in many cases. These operations are explained well and can be used in daily computer applications. A List of sorting and searching Algorithms and their efficiency are presented so that the best algorithm can be chosen.

articleTitle: Sunshine based models for estimation of monthly mean daily global solar radiation (Case studies of north eastern location (Patna) in India)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In learning of solar energy utilization, one should know about global solar radiation data precisely and it is compulsory on behalf of optimal design and evaluation of the performance of any solar energy conversion system. In this topic, a north-eastern location in India (Patna) as case studies, six models based on empirical formula are like quadratic, cubic, logarithmic, exponential and exponent i.e. derivative of Angstrom- Prescott obtained linear regression model; relating the global solar radiation data with the sunshine data. Estimate the coefficients (constants) of different models by the curve estimation technique with the help of curve fitting in MATLAB. Utilizing seven statistical indicators, correlation among estimated and determined global solar radiation has been performed. As a result, the quadratic model is obtained as the most appropriate for the expectation of solar radiation in Patna. Also, this model may then be utilized for areas in India with comparative meteorological and geological attributes at which sun-based information is not available.

articleTitle: Optical Character Recognition Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Optical Character recognition is an eminent topic of research in modern times. An exhaustive research is going on character recognition of different languages. These languages mainly include English and Devanagiri in India. A lot of research has been carried out already in the English language. Devanagiri consists of over 120 regional languages, which is a current topic of research nowadays. Character recognition is done on two types of documents typed and handwritten. In case of Indian and other languages OCR systems are not yet able to recognize the characters successfully with 100 percent reliability because of variation in scripts, quality, size, font, and style. Various algorithms are being developed now days for increasing the reliability of these characters for accurate recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis of Brain Tumor using Pre-trained CNN Models and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: A brain tumor is a life-threatening illness that disrupts the human body's natural functioning. Early detection of brain tumors is important for an accurate diagnosis and successful treatment strategy. The categorization of a brain tumor is based on the physician's expertise and understanding. However, for timely brain tumor analysis, an automated approach is necessary. The three feature extraction models presented in this article, namely VGG16, VGG19, and Inception v3, give important but easy combination approaches that can generate better and more accurate predictions. Also, machine learning classifiers aid in the categorization of benign (non-cancerous) and malignant (cancerous) brain tumors. With VGG16 and a neural network classifier, the present work had the greatest accuracy of 99.4 %.

articleTitle: NavIC Driven Dynamic Ambulance Allocation and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Emergency medical services provide urgent prehospital treatment, stabilization for serious illness, injuries and transport to definitive care. Private, public emergency vehicle administrations are working in more numbers today as an unavoidable service serving patients at critical moments. The process of calling, allocating an ambulance is multistep, time-consuming which increases the effective time in which a patient can receive medical aid. The paper discusses the use of NavIC-the Indian navigation technology. The ambulance allocation system uses NavIC tracking units to track ambulances. The unit constantly sends location data to the server and the database. The nearest ambulance having the shortest response time, computed using the distance matrix API is allocated to the user. The driver of the ambulance receives an SMS specifying the user location. The user gets information about the probable arrival time and prediction of the nearest hospital determined by the Haversine formula.

articleTitle: A survey on: detection of skin cancer lesions using segmentation through dermoscopic images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In recent years the environment in which we are living become rougher by nature continuously which seems to create several problems to human beings where one of the most dangerous problem is cancer that needs to be detect in early stage and then to cure it as well. In this paper the diagnostic tools for the detection of skin cancer lesions in the form of Dermoscopic images that will ultimately help in reducing the melanoma-induced mortality. We have introduced segmentation technique which helps in the automated skin lesion diagnosis pipeline. Here, we have presented fast and fully-automatic algorithm for the detection of the skin cancer in Dermoscopic images which are invented by previous authors. In this paper we have also presented the problems which were detected in the previous work. The acquired skin images are preprocessed by median filter and segmented by Edge-based segmentation, Morphological segmentation and K-means clustering techniques. The statistical features mean and standard deviation and the texture features contrast and energy are calculated for all the segmented skin lesion images. The performance of the three segmentation techniques are compared and found that the K-Means algorithm generates better results without any over and under segmentation.

articleTitle: The Recent Advancements in Humanoid Robot Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Fantasy of humanoid robot analysts is to create a total “human-like” counterfeit specialist both as far as body and mind. The field of humanoids advanced mechanics is broadly perceived as the ebb and flow challenge for advanced mechanics. Humanoid research is a way to deal with, comprehend and understand the mind boggling genuine communications between a robot, a climate and human. The humanoid advanced mechanics spurs social associations, for example, signal correspondence or co-employable errands in similar settings as the actual elements. This is fundamental for three-term connection, which targets intertwining physical and social communication at central levels. We presently have seen an expanding number of humanoid robots, (for example, Honda's ASIMO, ARMAR-3, NAO, ATLAS and numerous others). These show just a predetermined number of intellectual abilities as far as insight, learning and dynamic.

articleTitle: Short term Common Emission and Economic Dispatch modelling of Conventional and Renewable resources power generation using Differential Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: Optimization approach for the load scheduling across Thermal, Hydro, Wind, Solar and Nuclear power plants is a multi-objective optimization problem involving many constraints. The optimization problem has been formulated keeping two factors in mind, viz. total operating cost and total NOx, SOx and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission. The base load and peak load requirement idea has been used for deciding the priority of generator selection. In case of thermal power plants, the emission is given equal importance as the economic side. The decision is made with the help of Differential Particle Swarm Optimization (DPSO). The computational analysis of the problem is done on the MATLAB platform. The methodology is compared and evaluated on various effectiveness factors through an example. The generation schedule obtained is compared on basis of economic and nature friendliness.

Author Keywords: Common Emission and Economic Dispatch (CEED) model

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using Transformer Based Pre-Trained Models for the Hindi Language
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: India has one of the largest user bases for Internet-based services. In 2021, India had 624 million internet users, the second largest in the world<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2021-india. With so many internet users, each generating lots of textual data, having tools to analyze the data can be very helpful to a wide variety of people including researchers, marketers, and product managers. Research regarding Sentiment Analysis in English is plentiful, but we need a different method to perform the same in Hindi, one of the most popular languages of the Indian subcontinent. In this paper, we use Transformer-based pre-trained models on Hindi Sentiment Analysis tasks. The sentiment analysis task is done on a dataset that has Hindi text and its corresponding sentiment as Positive, Negative, and Neutral. The Hindi text contains sentences collected from various sites. The sentences primarily contain product and movie reviews. The sentiment analysis is done using five different transformer-based models, out of which a few have been trained for multiple languages while the others have been fine-tuned specifically for the Hindi language. We also compare the performance of a few different multilingual models on sentiment analysis tasks. Out of all the models compared, we get the best accuracy of 82% from the Hindi Microsoft Multilingual-MiniLM-L12-H384 model.

articleTitle: A Review on Sliding Mode Controller in Real- Time Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE International Students' Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Computer Science (SCEECS)
abstract: In current improvement in the control field, progressed control calculations are set up for the frameworks under the variety of state-space vulnerabilities due to displaying errors, nonlinearities, and outside instabilities. Amongst the diverse, vigorous control algorithms sliding-mode-control (SMC) is one such meant for the regulator technologist because of its benefits. Sliding-mode-control has developed quickly as a control in examination with other substantial control because of its highlights such as unresponsive toward vulnerabilities, decreased order sliding mode conditions, and nonlinear control. The reactions of the framework for SMC and PID regulators are acquired utilizing SIMULINK, and the outcomes are thought about. Here PID is taken as a reference controller.
